LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 9.1.1 PRESENTATION SKILLS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.1: Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Presentation Skills
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Presentation Skills, part of Strand 9 in Grade 7 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: How can we make a compelling presentation? 2. Why should we appreciate bodies charged with the maintenance of our roads?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. watch a recorded presentation and list key points discussed,

2. brainstorm with peers the issues to consider before and during a presentation,

3. work jointly with peers to select a sub-topic on patriotism and prepare a presentation on the role of the government agencies (Kenya Roads Board and Kenya Rural Roads Authority) in the construction and maintenance of roads, 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. watch a recorded presentation and list key points discussed,
2. brainstorm with peers the issues to consider before and during a presentation,
3. work jointly with peers to select a sub-topic on patriotism and prepare a presentation on the role of the government agencies (Kenya Roads Board and Kenya Rural Roads Authority) in the construction and maintenance of roads, 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Presentation Skills together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to Learn: This is enhanced as the learner develops relationships with peers when working jointly to select a

topic on the theme and prepare a presentation on it.

• Digital Literacy: This is acquired as the learner interacts with technology when collaborating with peers to record

themselves when making the presentations.

49

Values:
• Patriotism: This is promoted as the learner exhibits honesty and dedication when making a short talk on the topic

selected during a public speaking contest.

• Respect: This is achieved as the learner appreciates diverse opinions when engaging the presenter in a question-and- answer session on the topic presented.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Nationalism is promoted as the learner works jointly with peers to select a sub-topic on patriotism and prepares a

presentation on it.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner relates the concept of presentation skills to similar concepts in Creative Arts and Sports.
